description: sRGB8 group coverage on 8-bit ties below 1/2 (compositor-float32-residual.md open item, decision 067), on the stack of group-coverage-order s1: per texture set a root fill of uniform 0 at opacity 1, a group (Normal, 1, no mask) holding a child fill of fields B under a mask (Black background, mask fill of grey B: m = y/255) and a top fill of fields A in Normal. Top opacity per set i and channel j of User0-User7 (sRGB8): (2k + 1)/510 with k = 64 + 8i + j, so row 0 puts the coverage on the tie (k + 1/2)/255 for k = 64..127; User8 (sRGB8) and User9 (RGB32F control) per set: 0.3, 0.1, 1/6, 9/34, 7/34, 11/34, 7/30, 11/30.
